major_events.event_label: Exploration of Tianzun's Sea of Wheel and Discovery of the Bitter Sea
major_events.description: Ye Fan, Pang Bo, and the twelve saints arrive in a pitch-black, toxic ocean that they identify as the Sea of Wheel (Dantian) of a mythical-era Tianzun. They begin exploring its properties, realizing it contains both lethal poisons and immense life force.

major_events.event_label: Discovery of the Lingbao Array Diagram and the Four Swords
major_events.description: The group witnesses the legendary Four Swords of Lingbao Tianzun flying through the sky alongside a massive array diagram. This discovery triggers intense conflict as various extraterrestrial cultivators rush in to capture these supreme weapons.

major_events.event_label: Five Years of Seclusion and Bodhi Tree Sprouting
major_events.description: Ye Fan retreats inside the Sea of Wheel for five years. During this period, the ancient Bodhi seed he carries undergoes a miraculous Nirvana (涅槃), sprouting into a Bodhi tree (丈六菩提) that assists him in cultivating his Daoist comprehension.

major_events.event_label: Acquisition of the Four Extremes Scripture and Seclusion Exit
major_events.description: Ye Fan successfully obtains the Four Extremes Scripture (四极经) to refine his limbs. He exits his seclusion with significantly enhanced physical power, ready to confront the external threats.

major_events.event_label: Defeat of Jin She Er Lang Jun and Exploration of Gods Backyard
evidence_anchors: 第1423章 绝望的金蛇二郎君
major_events.description: Ye Fan defeats Jin She Er Lang Jun, leaving him in despair. Afterward, he enters the Backyard of the Gods, a massive graveyard of divine corpses, bones, and remnants.

major_events.event_label: Pursuit of God-Demon Liquid and the Divine Soul Pond
major_events.description: The group searches for the God-Demon Liquid, a liquid essence formed from the decaying bodies of ancient gods. They enter a forbidden zone and discover the Divine Soul Pond, which holds lethal mental remnants.

major_events.event_label: Reunion of Ye Fan and Ji Ziyue
major_events.description: Ye Fan finally reunites with Ji Ziyue in the Backyard of the Gods, which brings emotional relief and strengthens their resolve to fight together against mutual enemies.

major_events.event_label: Creation of Emperor Fist and Battle in Forbidden Domain
major_events.description: Surrounded by powerful Saint King enemies, Ye Fan creates the Emperor's Fist (天帝拳) in a bloody battle. He triggers the Forbidden Domain (神禁) and sweeps away multiple powerful opponents.

major_events.event_label: Climax of the Other Shore Arc and Seizure of Immortal Swords
major_events.description: Cultivators launch a final charge to capture the four immortal swords from the Shinto Domain (神域). With the swords scattered, the Other Shore (彼岸) arc comes to a close.

major_events.event_label: Traversing the Human Ancient Road and Writing Name on Crystal Monument
major_events.description: Ye Fan completes the remaining passes of the human ancient road and writes his name on the final Crystal Monument, sealing his reputation as a top-tier cultivator.

major_events.event_label: Return to Beidou and Visit to the Ji Family
major_events.description: Ye Fan returns to his home planet of Beidou after years of space travel. He visits the Ji Family, demonstrating his immense growth and securing his relationship with them.

major_events.event_label: Campaign at Mount Xumi and Extreme Imperial Weapon Clash
major_events.description: A massive battle breaks out at Mount Xumi. Various factions unleash imperial weapons, including the Heaven-Swallowing Demon Jar (吞天魔罐), in a clash of extreme power (极道战).

major_events.event_label: Suppression of Mount Xumi and Opening of the Coffin
major_events.description: The nine-layered divine coffin is used to suppress the Buddhist faith power of Mount Xumi, concluding the campaign and resulting in the conversion of many Buddhist followers.

major_events.event_label: Journey to Ziwei Star and Reunion with Little Nannan
major_events.description: Ye Fan travels to the Ziwei Star to locate Little Nannan. He finds her safe, and settles past conflicts on the ice plains, demonstrating his absolute dominance.

major_events.event_label: Breakthrough to Great Saint and Marriage to Ji Ziyue
major_events.description: Ye Fan breaks through to the Great Saint (大圣) realm. After returning to Beidou, he and Ji Ziyue hold a grand wedding celebration amidst the impending threat of the Road to Immortality.

major_events.event_label: Opening of the Road to Immortality and Awakening of Restricted Zone Supremes
major_events.description: The Road to Immortality (成仙路) opens, causing the Ancient Forbidden Land to collapse. Slumbering ancient Supremes wake up, release their terrifying auras, and charge into the rift.

major_events.event_label: Outbreak of the Dark Turmoil and Fight of Earth's Heroes
major_events.description: After failing to ascend, the Supremes initiate the Dark Turmoil to harvest life essence. The Earth heroes (Laozi, Shennong, Huangdi, Shakyamuni), who possess the bodies of ancient Emperors but new souls, sacrifice themselves to fight the Supremes.

major_events.event_label: The Sacrifice of Void and Hengyu and the Survival of Ye Fan
major_events.description: The reanimated spirit of the Sun Emperor fades away. The remnant spirit and blood of Void Emperor and Hengyu Emperor sacrifice themselves in combat. Three hundred years pass, and Ye Fan, thought dead, is revealed to have survived.

character_state_transitions.description: Transitions from the Saint King realm to the Great Saint (大圣) realm, obtaining combat power that allows him to dominate star systems.
Transitions from standard combat methods to mastering the Emperor's Fist (天帝拳) and triggering the Forbidden Domain (神禁), allowing him to bypass boundary limitations.
Transitions from a solitary seeker to a husband by marrying Ji Ziyue, fulfilling their long-standing emotional commitment.
Transitions from a mortally wounded, seemingly dead martyr of the Dark Turmoil to a living survivor returning to the universe after 300 years of recovery.
Transitions from a separated, anxious lover to being reunited with Ye Fan in the Backyard of the Gods.
Transitions from a maiden of the Ji family to Ye Fan's wife, though immediately separated from him by the subsequent cataclysms.
Transitions from a sealed, slumbering Supreme in the轮回海 (Reincarnation Sea) to an active hunter harvesting billions of lives to sustain himself.
Transitions from a dormant human skin relic to a temporarily reanimated protector of humanity, and finally to a completely collapsed and faded entity.

evidence_anchors: 第1605章 人生最后一战
character_state_transitions.description: Transitions from a dormant guardian to an active combatant burning Wushi's blood to fight the Supremes, ending in his heroic death.
Transitions from a new corpse-derived consciousness (Huang Di) to a fused hero who reawakens the Void Emperor's blood and spirit to fight for humanity.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Tianzun's Sea of Wheel (天尊轮海)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A gargantuan cultivation ecosystem that is actually the lower abdomen and Sea of Wheel (Dantian) of a deceased myth-era Tianzun. The water is a bitter sea containing both toxic waves and pure life essence, inhabited by ancient artifacts.

A supreme substance that forms in the Backyard of the Gods over ten thousand years from the decaying bodies and bones of ancient deities. It matures periodically and is collected by supreme beings to extend life or force breakthroughs.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Forbidden Domain / God Forbidden (神禁 / 禁忌领域)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A combat state that allows a cultivator to break past the standard limits of combat (the 'Eight Forbidden') and fight enemies who are several minor realms above them, triggered during intense, life-threatening combat.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Power of Faith / Devotion (信仰之力 / 念力)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A resource gathered from the worship and thoughts of millions of believers. Used by Amitabha Buddha and the Shinto Domain to protect mountains, power weapons, or maintain longevity, though highly vulnerable to imperial coffins.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Nine-Layered Divine Coffin (九层神棺 / 三世铜棺)
long_form_mechanisms.description: An ancient, mysterious artifact capable of suppressing massive reservoirs of spiritual energy (like the faith power of Mount Xumi) and preserving ancient corpses, linked to pre-myth histories.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Immortal Realm Rift & Road to Immortality (仙路 / 仙域裂缝)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A cosmic event occurring once in millions of years where the boundary of the Immortal Realm weakens. slumbering Supremes wake up, release their seal, and charge into the rift in search of true immortality.
A survival mechanism where failed Supremes, to prevent their lifespans from ending immediately after unsealing, consume the life essence (生灵精气) of trillions of sentient beings in the universe.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Sacrificial Resurrection / Reawakening of Emperor Blood (帝血复苏 / 信仰重塑)
long_form_mechanisms.description: The process by which descendant bloodlines or universal faith temporarily reanimates the weapons, blood, or skins of deceased Emperors, allowing them to fight with Emperor-level power.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Supreme Self-Amputation & Utmost Sublimation (自斩一刀 / 极尽升华)
long_form_mechanisms.description: The mechanism where an Emperor cuts their own cultivation to enter a slumber. During battle, they can perform Utmost Sublimation to return to their peak, flawless Emperor state, which is a one-way trip resulting in death unless they consume massive life essence.

continuity_observations.observation: Size scaling discrepancy of the Nine-Layered Coffin
continuity_observations.description: In previous arcs (like the Earth arc), the bronze coffin is small enough to fit inside the Nine Dragons, but here it is described as a stone/bronze coffin 'as huge as a mountain, thousands of feet high,' representing a sudden scaling up without explanation.

Originally portrayed as normal human cultivators who achieved high realms, Laozi and Shakyamuni are retconned to be the reanimated corpse spirits of Daode Tianzun and Amitabha Buddha to explain their identical appearance to the ancient figures.

continuity_observations.observation: Violation of the 'One Door, Two Emperors' rule
continuity_observations.description: The narrative repeatedly states that an Emperor's bloodline suppression prevents their children from proving the Dao. However, Wushi is revealed to be the son of the Western Queen Mother, which violates this rule, excused only by his 'uniqueness'.

The children of restricted zone Supremes are introduced as sealed ancient geniuses. However, their combat performance and quick defeat by Ye Fan's faction contradicts their status as heirs of the universe's most powerful beings.

continuity_observations.observation: Habitability of a shattered Beidou planet
continuity_observations.description: The Lord of Reincarnation steps on Beidou, shattering it into five floating continents. Despite the destruction, later chapters treat Beidou as still habitable and cohesive, with little explanation of how the atmosphere or gravity holds.

The God-Demon Liquid is built up as a supreme substance that can extend life and cause major breakthroughs. However, after the battle, its actual cultivation effects on Ye Fan's core group are barely discussed, serving mostly as a plot device to attract enemies.

continuity_observations.observation: Inconsistency of the Great Saints' Lifespan
continuity_observations.description: Buddhist Great Saints at Mount Xumi appear to have lived for hundreds of thousands of years, contradicting the established rule that non-Emperor cultivators have a strict lifespan limit of around ten thousand years unless sealed in source stones.

continuity_observations.observation: Extended duration of deceased Emperor reanimation
continuity_observations.description: The Void Mirror summons the blood and spirit of the Void Emperor to fight at near-peak Emperor levels for a prolonged period. This level of power and duration contradicts the rule that deceased Emperors cannot return and that weapons only hold a fraction of their power.

style_observations.description: Repetitive use of extreme hyperboles (e.g., 'shattering ten thousand stars', 'tearing the universe with a single step') to convey the power of the Supremes, creating a grand but repetitive mythic scale.

The prose shifts to a highly emotional, tragic tone during the martyrdom of ancient Emperors, emphasizing the contrast between their past glory and their current dying states as they protect humanity.
Frequent reuse of specific epic lines (e.g., '仙路尽头谁为峰，一见无始道成空') to emphasize the legendary status of historical figures and create a sense of historical weight.

style_observations.observation: Contrast between Cosmic Grandeur and Red-Dust Emotion
style_observations.description: Balancing massive, universe-spanning battles with intimate, domestic milestones like Ye Fan's wedding to Ji Ziyue, highlighting that the ultimate goal of cultivation is to protect fragile human bonds.

style_observations.observation: Use of Corpse/Reanimation Tropes for Lore Delivery
style_observations.description: Relying on characters finding ancient graves, coffins, or corpse spirits (like Shen Nong and Huang Di) to reveal historical secrets, making the past a physical and confrontable presence.
Alternating between very slow, details-oriented cultivation and exploration sequences (five years in seclusion) and rapid, high-stakes battles where major planets are destroyed within a few chapters.

creation_family_evidence.serialized_platform_features: Cleaned chronological chapters prefixed by '第xxxx章' (e.g., '第1411章 苦海', '第1619章 平静地杀人') with regular lengths of 2000-3000 Chinese characters, which is a classic daily-serialized web novel layout.
creation_family_evidence.recap_expository_transitions: Frequent use of transition sentences at the start of chapters summarizing the previous chapter's cliffhanger to re-engage readers who follow the story on a daily basis.
creation_family_evidence.stylistic_genre: Xianxia / Xuanhuan serialized web novel under the Qidian platform styling, exhibiting characteristic high-hyperbolic power scaling and emotional ancestral sacrifice arcs.

originality_risks.risk_name: Direct Borrowing of Chinese Mythological Figures
originality_risks.description: The characters Laozi (道德天尊/李耳), Shen Nong (神农), Huang Di (黄帝), and Shakyamuni (释迦牟尼) are taken directly from real-world history and mythology. While reframed as corpse spirits, their design relies heavily on pre-existing cultural associations.

originality_risks.risk_name: Plagiarizing the 'Four Swords of Tongtian' System
originality_risks.description: The concept of the Four Swords (诛仙四剑) and the Array Diagram (阵图) associated with Lingbao Tianzun/Tongtian Jiaozhu is lifted directly from the Ming-era classic novel Investiture of the Gods (《封神演义》), reducing the originality of the high-level weaponry.

The core mechanism of ancient, powerful beings slumbering in hidden zones and waking up periodically to consume the life force of the universe to sustain themselves is a common trope in western sci-fi and cosmic horror (such as the Reapers in Mass Effect), adapted to fantasy settings.

originality_risks.description: The plot follows a highly formulaic cycle: the protagonist enters seclusion, obtains a secret manual, exits seclusion to immediately crush an arrogant rival who has been hunting his friends, and moves to a larger stage, which is a standard xianxia progression.
